ruleDefinitions.name: Local System Accounts Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local systeam accounts. This information can help adversaries determine which local accounts exist on a system to aid in follow-on behavior.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/lastlog$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'x\\:0\\:\\.*") OR ((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ed$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nano$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vim$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/less$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/emacs$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sqlite3$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/makemap$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/passwd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/shadow.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/sudoers.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/spwd\\\.db.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/pwd\\\.db.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/master\\\.passwd.*"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\/id$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\/lsof$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u.*")))
